config.description: Optional. Searching, car lookups, price checks, introductions and standing wants all work with no key at 30 calls a minute per IP; keyless watches are capped at 3, re-check every 6 hours, last 7 days and are polled rather than pushed. A free key (https://iwant.fyi/api/agents/register) adds webhooks, more and faster watches, and the seller-side tools.
